claims.quote: It inhabits Malaysia and Southern Thailand.
It inhabits Malaysia and Southern Thailand.
Distributed throughout Peninsular Malaysia where it's been recorded from the Terengganu, Perak, Tahan, Muar, Jelai, Endau, Mersing and Sedili river basins.
It also occurs in the Sai Buri, Bang Nara and Kolok river systems, southern Thailand.
